name: varg-previz
description: Plan and pre-visualise any multi-shot AI video before spending credits on varg - music videos, ads and product promos, UGC-style spots, trailers, short films, explainers. Collect film references into a moodboard, write the story (Hero's Journey, hook-problem-payoff, 3-act), lock character/product/vehicle sheets and one master plate per location, group shots into master scenes, block every camera in a three.js grey-box previz on the timeline (auto cameras from plain storyboard words like "MCU, 3/4 left, push in"), then export clean previz clips as @video1 references for Seedance 2.5 video-to-video and run one short generation per scene. Any aspect ratio, with or without a song; lock voice, music and beats before picture. Use when the user asks for a previz, a 3D animatic, camera blocking or approval, shot lists, scene grouping, character or product sheets, story structure for a clip or ad, or a Seedance video-to-video pack, a moodboard or references for a video.
